title: chylismia specicola
intro: Chylismia specicola, commonly known as the evening primrose, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Onagraceae. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve heart health, and alleviate symptoms of menopause and eczema. The therapeutic actions of Chylismia specicola include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilator, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), a polyunsaturated fatty acid that is responsible for many of its therapeutic actions.
